verdict.rationale: The story accepts an ecosystem of AI plugins, and Obsidian's documented community plugin system (including integrations with third-party services) is backed by hands-on reports of AI plugins: Text-Generator, which pulls links and backlinks into LLM context, and Copilot, which works with self-hosted LLMs. There is no first-party AI connector, users note there is no decent RAG, and the Copilot author pushes a paid service. Missing for 10: first-party LLM/AI connectors, first-party documentation of AI plugins, solid RAG over the vault, and broader independent corroboration of the AI plugin ecosystem.
